SELECT i_item_id, AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM item
JOIN customer_demographics ON item.i_item_sk = store_sales.ss_item_sk AND customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'F' AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'College'
JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk IS NULL OR (store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk AND promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' AND promotion.p_channel_event = 'N' AND date_dim.d_year = 2001)
JOIN promotion ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk AND promotion.p_channel_event = 'N' AND date_dim.d_year = 2001
WHERE true
GROUP BY i_item_id
ORDER BY i_item_id LIMIT 100
